entry.summary: Compare x402 and Tempo’s MPP for HTTP 402-based API payments, including protocol design, payment methods, charge vs session billing, settlement and receipts, and when to use each with Quicknode’s x402 SDKs or its MPP endpoint for machine-to-machine and RPC workflows.
